items.intro_zh: 发帘是德宇的核心产品。发丝经分拣、双抽、顺鳞后在自有车间缝制，提供机制、手工与超薄无痕三类，纹理与色号可整套配套。
items.description_en: Double-drawn bundles with minimal shedding - the foundation of our wholesale business.
items.description_zh: 双抽工艺发束，掉发少，是批发业务的基础产品。
items.intro_en: Wefts are our core product. Hair is sorted, double-drawn and sewn in our own workshop, with cuticles kept in one direction. Machine wefts, hand-tied wefts and ultra-thin genius wefts are available in matching textures and colours.

items.intro_zh: 发块前头与发帘取自同一批发丝，整套安装的纹理、色泽与光泽保持一致。可选透明蕾丝、HD 蕾丝与丝网底，支持自由分缝、中分与三七分。
items.description_en: Small-lace pieces with a natural parting, made to match our wefts and bundles exactly.
items.description_zh: 小面积蕾丝补发片，分缝自然，可与同批号发帘完美配套。
items.intro_en: Closures and frontals are produced from the same hair batch as our wefts, so texture, colour and lustre stay consistent across a full install. Available in transparent, HD and silk-base lace with free, middle or three-part parting.

items.intro_zh: 马尾系列强调快速佩戴与稳固贴合，采用与发帘同等级的真人发，配缠绕式、抽绳式或抓夹式隐形固定结构。
items.description_en: Fast, secure attachment pieces in straight, wavy and curly textures.
items.description_zh: 佩戴快捷、固定牢靠，直发、波浪与卷发纹理齐备。
items.subtitle_zh: 缠绕式、抽绳式与抓夹马尾
items.intro_en: Our ponytail range is designed for quick, secure everyday wear. Each piece is made with the same graded human hair as our wefts and finished with a discreet wrap, drawstring or claw-clip attachment.

items.intro_zh: 我们的卡子发可以快速进行自我佩戴与稳固贴合，采用与发帘同等级的真人发，不同方位的头发进行添加
items.description_en: Clip-in hair pieces can be easily self-applied and secured snugly. Made of premium human hair of the same grade as hair wefts, they allow you to add hair volume at different positions.
items.description_zh: 片式卡子发可以快速进行自我佩戴与稳固贴合，采用与发帘同等级的真人发，不同方位的头发进行添加
items.intro_en: Clip-in hair pieces can be easily self-applied and secured snugly. Made of premium human hair of the same grade as hair wefts, they allow you to add hair volume at different positions.

items.intro_zh: 面向沙龙的专业接发系统，长度与色号稳定、批次一致。
items.description_en: our extension range is built for salon professionals who need predictable grams per piece, reliable adhesive and repeatable shades across reorders.

items.intro_zh: 头套系列包含前额蕾丝、全蕾丝、360 与免胶结构。全部在自有车间手工钩织，采用毛鳞片顺向真人发，出货前逐顶检查发际线、密度与掉发量。
items.description_en: Ready-to-wear wigs built on lace front, full lace and glueless bases, in every texture and length your market asks for.
items.subtitle_en: Lace front, full lace & glueless wigs
items.description_zh: 涵盖前额蕾丝、全蕾丝与免胶底，纹理与长度可按目标市场灵活配置。
items.subtitle_zh: 前额蕾丝、全蕾丝与免胶头套
items.intro_en: Our wig line covers lace front, full lace, 360 and glueless constructions. Every unit is hand-ventilated in our own workshop with cuticle-aligned human hair, then checked for hairline, density and shedding before packing.
